title: 5D derived view
description: A derived view record (spec/SPEC.md §15; the four 'kind' values each name a §14 view — position, match_statistic, d, and nesting_level). Mirrors five_d_nd/views.make_view()/view_violations(). 'staleness_tier' is one of the CLOSED enum (five_d_nd.views.STALENESS_TIERS) when stale is true, and MUST be null when stale is false — the cross-field 'stale implies tier present, non-stale implies tier absent' rule is code-only (views.make_view()/view_violations() apply it); this schema only pins each field's own type.
